name: Glassmorphism
description: Frosted glass: deep soft radii, cards edged in a specular inner light line inside a faint outer line, rules doubled in a translucent line, controls in the strong border color, frosted-glass surfaces, normal density, medium elevation, and fluid motion.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's glass recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: Translucent surfaces with a backdrop blur cost paint time on slower devices, and read less clearly over busy content.
Its emphasis motion, float-once, has no keyframes in the platform yet, so it doesn't animate.

tokens.surface-material: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-prominent) 52%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-default) 74%, transparent))
tokens.shadow-card: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 75%, transparent), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 14%, transparent), 0 10px 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 16%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 80%, transparent), 0 22px 60px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 22%, transparent)
